title: Complete chest state compositions
coordinate_space: Original GLB scene coordinates, +Y up, before viewer normalization. Sprite outputs share a 1024-pixel canvas.
magic_envelope: Position is the base cavity anchor; size is centered in X/Z and extends upward by size.y, including sprite extents.

state_semantics.closed: Closed lid; treasure and magic hidden
state_semantics.open: Opened lid with empty cavity; treasure and magic hidden
state_semantics.treasure: Opened lid with real sourced treasure visible; magic hidden
state_semantics.magic: Opened lid with textured light and spark effects; treasure hidden

authorship: State compositions supplement the acquired original models and sprites; they do not claim new source animation clips.
